verdict.rationale: Cloudflare offers natural-language access to your own account data through managed MCP servers (Observability, Logpush, DNS Analytics, Audit Logs, AI Gateway), plus built-in observability and AI Gateway metrics. That access goes through an external MCP client such as Claude or Cursor rather than a native in-product assistant. AI Search lets you query your indexed data in natural language, but it is a building block for your own apps, not a feature that proactively generates insights. missing for 10: a native in-dashboard AI assistant, proactive AI-generated insights or suggestions about your Workers data, and independent hands-on corroboration.
